key_insight: KKT Atlas learns compact local scenario models that preserve decision-relevant optimality conditions instead of approximating the full uncertainty distribution.
engineering_relevance: It reduces the cost of training and deploying contextual stochastic optimizers while maintaining competitive operational risk.
method: Partition contexts into local charts and learn low-dimensional subspaces from scenario-cost decision gradients.
Jointly fit shared scenario coordinates and context-dependent probabilities.
Under regularity conditions, use one more scenario than the subspace dimension to approximate conditional KKT optimality.
evidence_signal: Across three synthetic problems, Atlas uses 4–18 scenarios versus 500, with comparable or lower risk and 13–61× faster batch deployment; European grid tests compress 728 scenarios to 8–9.
watch_item: Decision and risk bounds require local strong convexity; on 17 later grid quarters, Atlas had slightly higher loss than full-support integrated learning.
paper_title: KKT Atlas: Learning Low-Dimensional Local Scenario Models for Contextual Stochastic Optimization
